questions.question: What was California's unadjusted current expenditure per pupil in the 2020-21 school year?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_expenditure_per_pupil_by_state.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2023 Table 236.65', header=None)
cols_2020_21 = [c for c in df.columns if '2020-21' in str(df.iloc[2, c])]
col_unadj = cols_2020_21[0]
ca_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'California']
result = float(ca_row.iloc[0, col_unadj])

questions.question: Between New York and New Jersey, which state had the higher current expenditure per pupil in constant 2022-23 dollars during the 2020-21 school year?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_expenditure_per_pupil_by_state.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2023 Table 236.65', header=None)
cols_2020_21 = [c for c in df.columns if '2020-21' in str(df.iloc[2, c])]
col_const = cols_2020_21[1]
ny_val = float(df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'New York'].iloc[0, col_const])
nj_val = float(df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'New Jersey'].iloc[0, col_const])
result = 'New York' if ny_val > nj_val else 'New Jersey'

questions.question: Which three states had the highest current expenditures per pupil in constant 2022-23 dollars in 2020-21, excluding the District of Columbia?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_expenditure_per_pupil_by_state.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2023 Table 236.65', header=None)
cols_2020_21 = [c for c in df.columns if '2020-21' in str(df.iloc[2, c])]
col_const = cols_2020_21[1]
states_df = df.iloc[5:56].copy()
states_df = states_df[states_df[0].astype(str).str.strip() != 'District of Columbia']
states_df['val'] = pd.to_numeric(states_df[col_const], errors='coerce')
top3 = states_df.sort_values(by='val', ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3[0].str.strip().tolist()

questions.question: In constant 2022-23 dollars, did the United States national average per-pupil expenditure increase from 2018-19 to 2019-20?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_expenditure_per_pupil_by_state.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2023 Table 236.65', header=None)
us_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'United States']
cols_2018_19 = [c for c in df.columns if '2018-19' in str(df.iloc[2, c])]
cols_2019_20 = [c for c in df.columns if '2019-20' in str(df.iloc[2, c])]
col_const_1819 = cols_2018_19[1]
col_const_1920 = cols_2019_20[1]
val_1819 = float(us_row.iloc[0, col_const_1819])
val_1920 = float(us_row.iloc[0, col_const_1920])
result = 'yes' if val_1920 > val_1819 else 'no'
